### Findings
Across authorized products enforced via executor-bound views, order item records joined with products were aggregated at the product category grain with filter `status = 'Complete'`. No date filter was applied [q1]. Total complete revenue (`SUM(sale_price)`) is 210.0 across 14 complete items (`COUNT(*)`), all belonging to the Outerwear category [q1].

| category | complete_revenue | complete_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Outerwear | 210.0 | 14 |

### Limitations
- The query filtered strictly for completed items and did not return records for other order statuses (such as cancelled or returned items) [q1].
- No date constraints were applied, so the distribution of items across time and chronological coverage were not measured [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
- How is completed Outerwear revenue and item volume distributed across time when grouped by calendar month or year?
- What are the distinct order count (`COUNT(DISTINCT order_key)`) and distinct customer count (`COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key)`) for these completed items?
